# No REQUIRES list: "main" may use every component in the build (BSP, LVGL,
# ESP-Iris, recovery support, cJSON), which avoids managed-component naming.
# quotes_data.c, tz_table.c and fonts/*.ttf are generated by tools/ (see README).
idf_component_register(
    SRCS "main.c" "wifi.c" "clock_time.c" "clock_ui.c" "quotes.c" "quotes_data.c" "tz_table.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    EMBED_FILES "fonts/literata_regular.ttf" "fonts/literata_bold.ttf" "fonts/literata_italic.ttf")
